content: swaggo/swag remains active default for annotation-based OpenAPI in Go; swag/v2 module emits OpenAPI 3.x. Known pain points: gin-swagger UI serving quirks, files v2 compat delays. Alternatives (oapi-codegen spec-first, ogen codegen, Swagno) exist but no consensus replacement. Embed of generated docs.json + single UI route is a common lightweight serving pattern.
